constraints: Do not interpret objective as executable logic
Do not generate dossier in Gate7B
Legacy jobs must preserve current behavior
Fail closed when required deliverables are missing
objective: Implementar globalmente el contrato backward-compatible required_deliverables del Universal Worker. Separar el PASS mecanico de checks del cumplimiento funcional del job. Los jobs legacy sin required_deliverables conservan el comportamiento actual. Los jobs que declaren entregables obligatorios no pueden recibir COMPLETE/100/CERTIFIED_READ_ONLY mientras falten entregables. Este Gate no interpreta objective ni genera dossiers; solo materializa la fundacion contractual.
